Warriors = }} '''Jared Armon Cunningham''' (born May 22, 1991) is an American professional [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for [[Oregon State Beavers men's basketball|Oregon State]], where he was an [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] first team selection before being selected with the 24th overall pick in the [[2012 NBA draft]] by the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]]. ==High school career== In his junior season at [[San Leandro High School]], Cunningham averaged 17.8 points, 4.5 rebounds and 3.3 assists per game. As a senior, He averaged 20.4 points, 6.3 rebounds and 2.6 assists per game. He earned academic All-America honors his senior year.{{cite web|title=#1 Jared Cunningham|url=http://www.osubeavers.com/ViewArticle.dbml?DB_OEM_ID=30800&ATCLID=207930649|work=OSUBeavers.com|access-date=January 1, 2014}} Considered a four-star recruit by [[Rivals.com]], Cunningham was listed as the No. 14 point guard and the No. 76 player in the nation in 2009.{{cite web|title=Jared Cunningham Recruiting Profile|url=https://n.rivals.com/content/prospects/maple/67845|work=Rivals.com|access-date=January 1, 2014}} ==College career== ===Freshman season=== In Cunningham's freshman season at [[Oregon State Beavers men's basketball|Oregon State]], he averaged 6.2 points, 2.0 rebounds, and 0.9 assists per game. In a first-round game against [[Boston University Terriers|Boston University]] in the [[2010 College Basketball Invitational]], he recorded a then career-high of 21 points. ===Sophomore season=== In his sophomore season, Cunningham averaged 14.2 points, 3.1 rebounds, 2.1 assists and 2.83 steals per game. He was first in the Pac-10 in steals and was also fifth in the nation. He was named to the All-Pac-10 Second Team and the Pac-10 All-Defensive-Team. He was also named to the Pac-10 All-Tournament Team after averaging 23.5 points per game in the [[2011 Pacific-10 Conference men's basketball tournament]]. ===Junior season=== In his junior season, he averaged 17.9 points, 3.8 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 2.53 steals per game. He led the [[Pac-12 Conference|Pac-12]] in steals per game for the second consecutive season, and also finished ninth nationally. Cunningham was also named to the [[List of All-Pac-12 Conference men's basketball teams|All-Pac-12]] First Team and the Pac-12 All-Defensive Team. Additionally, he was named to the Pac-12 All-Tournament team for the second consecutive season. On April 9, 2012, Jared declared for the [[2012 NBA draft]].{{cite web|first=Molly|last=Blue|title=Oregon State Beavers basketball: Jared Cunningham declares for the NBA draft (video)|url=http://www.oregonlive.com/beavers/index.ssf/2012/04/oregon_state_beavers_basketbal_103.html|work=OregonLive.com|date=April 9, 2012|access-date=January 1, 2014}} ==Professional career== [[File:Jared Cunningham.jpg|thumb|right|Cunningham with the Dallas Mavericks in 2012]] Cunningham was selected with the 24th overall pick in the [[2012 NBA draft]] by the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]]. His draft rights were then traded with [[Jae Crowder]] and [[Bernard James]] to the [[Dallas Mavericks]] in exchange for [[Tyler Zeller]] and [[Kelenna Azubuike]] on draft night. On July 21, 2012, he signed his rookie scale contract with the Mavericks.{{cite web|title=Mavs sign first-rounder Jared Cunningham|url=https://www.espn.com/blog/dallas/mavericks/post/_/id/4691079/mavs-sign-first-rounder-jared-cunningham|work=ESPN.com|date=July 21, 2012|access-date=January 1, 2014}} On December 11, 2012, he was assigned to the [[Texas Legends]].{{cite web|title=Jared Cunningham assigned to Texas Legends|url=https://www.espn.com/blog/dallas/mavericks/post/_/id/4693154/jared-cunningham-assigned-to-texas-legends|work=ESPN.com|date=December 11, 2012|access-date=January 1, 2014}} He was recalled by the Mavericks on December 31, 2012,{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/blog/dallas/mavericks/post/_/id/4693485/mavericks-recall-jared-cunningham|title=Mavericks recall Jared Cunningham|work=ESPN.com|date=December 31, 2012|access-date=January 1, 2014}} reassigned on January 28, 2013,{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/mavericks_assign_cunningham_2013_01_28.html|title=Dallas Mavericks Re-Assign Jared Cunningham to NBA D-League Affiliate Texas Legends|work=NBA.com|date=January 28, 2013|access-date=January 1, 2014}} and recalled again on March 30, 2013.{{cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=12900|title=Mavericks recall Jared Cunningham from D-League again|work=InsideHoops.com|date=March 30, 2013|access-date=January 1, 2014}} On June 27, 2013, Cunningham was traded to the [[Atlanta Hawks]] in a draft night deal,{{cite web|title=Atlanta Hawks 2013 Draft Central|url=http://www.nba.com/hawks/2013-draft-central|work=NBA.com|date=June 27, 2013|access-date=June 27, 2013}} and he later joined the Hawks for the [[2013 NBA Summer League]]. During his sophomore season, he had multiple assignments with the [[Bakersfield Jam]] of the [[NBA Development League]].{{cite web|title=2013-14 NBA Assignments |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2013_14.html |work=NBA.com |access-date=February 22, 2014 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140703151241/http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2013_14.html |archive-date=July 3, 2014 }} On February 22, 2014, he was waived by the Hawks.{{cite web|title=Atlanta Hawks waive Jared Cunningham|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=15283|work=InsideHoops.com|date=February 22, 2014|access-date=February 22, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140228182953/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=15283|archive-date=February 28, 2014|url-status=dead}} On March 31, 2014, Cunningham signed a 10-day contract with the [[Sacramento Kings]].{{cite web|title=Kings Sign Jared Cunningham to 10-Day Contract|url=http://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-sign-jared-cunningham-10-day-contract|work=NBA.com|date=March 31, 2014|access-date=March 31, 2014}} On April 10, 2014, he signed with the Kings for the rest of the season.{{cite web|title=Kings Sign Jared Cunningham for Remainder of the Season|url=http://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-sign-jared-cunningham-remainder-season|work=NBA.com|date=April 10, 2014|access-date=April 10, 2014}} In July 2014, he joined the Kings for the [[2014 NBA Summer League]] but did not receive a new contract offer from the team.
